# optionledger.flex_trade_row r1

optionledger.flex_trade_row r1: one revision of one Flex trade row of level EXECUTION, attributes as sent, as text; insert only. No account number is stored: the alias is the only identity.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| alias | string | no | Account alias of the row, the label mapped by the allow-list. |
| level_of_detail | string | no | Level of detail of the Flex row, for example EXECUTION. |
| transaction_id | string | no | Flex transactionID of the row, as text. |
| revision | integer | no | Revision of the row for its transaction; 1 for a new key, a changed row is the next revision. |
| fetch_id | string | no | Identifier of the fetch record that brought the row; for an import, the identifier of the import. |
| row_index | integer | no | Position of the row in its report. |
| source | enum(flex, ot_import) | no | Writer of the row: flex for a fetch, ot_import for the import of option-trader history. |
| attributes | string | no | JSON object as text: every attribute of the Trade row as sent, every value text. |
| attributes_sha256 | string | no | SHA-256 of the attributes text, 64 lower-case hex digits. |
| recorded_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the row was recorded, UTC. |
